name: Flowering habit
description: Whether a strawberry cultivar flowers in response to short daylength (short-day / June-bearing, concentrated harvest window) or largely independent of daylength (day-neutral / everbearing, extended-season production). The primary variety-differentiating trait for strawberry breeding programs, analogous in role to fruiting habit (trait-fruiting-habit) for caneberries; has no direct equivalent in blueberry. Added as part of the multi-berry portability audit (2026-08-20) for the same reason as trait-fruiting-habit -- the existing trait vocabulary was derived entirely from the blueberry-only pilot.
